<title>AD2 Découverte des ions · Labo virtuel EFIR</title>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin><link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Atkinson+Hyperlegible:wght@400;700&family=Bricolage+Grotesque:wght@600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
/* Paillasse : en-tête de fiche, puis deux colonnes (tubes à gauche, flacons et carnet à droite), une seule colonne sur téléphone */
:root {
  --bg: #eef2f5;          /* carrelage de paillasse, gris bleuté */
  --surface: #ffffff;
  --surface-2: #f6f8fa;
  --ink: #15212d;
  --muted: #576776;
  --line: #d3dce4;
  --navy: #003366;        /* bleu marine EFIR */
  --navy-soft: #e3ecf6;
  --red: #b42318;         /* sécurité, interdit */
  --red-soft: #fdecea;
  --green: #2f6f45;       /* vérifié */
  --green-soft: #e7f3eb;
  --amber: #8c6d1f;
  --amber-soft: #fbf3df;
  --glass: rgba(120, 150, 175, .55);
  --glass-fill: rgba(255, 255, 255, .55);
  --water: rgba(170, 205, 230, .38);
  --font-display: "Bricolage Grotesque", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --font-body: "Atkinson Hyperlegible", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --radius: 10px;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  :root:not([data-theme="light"]) {
    --bg: #0f1720; --surface: #17222e; --surface-2: #1d2a38; --ink: #e5ecf2; --muted: #9aaab9; --line: #2b3a49;
    --navy: #8bb8e8; --navy-soft: #1b2d42; --red: #ff8a7a; --red-soft: #3a1d1b; --green: #7fd09a; --green-soft: #183026;
    --amber: #e5c46e; --amber-soft: #33291a; --glass: rgba(170, 200, 225, .55); --glass-fill: rgba(255, 255, 255, .06);
    --water: rgba(150, 190, 225, .28); color-scheme: dark;
  }
}
:root[data-theme="dark"] {
  --bg: #0f1720; --surface: #17222e; --surface-2: #1d2a38; --ink: #e5ecf2; --muted: #9aaab9; --line: #2b3a49;
  --navy: #8bb8e8; --navy-soft: #1b2d42; --red: #ff8a7a; --red-soft: #3a1d1b; --green: #7fd09a; --green-soft: #183026;
  --amber: #e5c46e; --amber-soft: #33291a; --glass: rgba(170, 200, 225, .55); --glass-fill: rgba(255, 255, 255, .06);
  --water: rgba(150, 190, 225, .28); color-scheme: dark;
}
* { box-sizing: border-box; }
body {
  background: var(--bg); color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.55;
  padding-left: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px)); padding-right: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px));
  padding-block: 20px 40px;
}
.wrap { max-width: 1180px; margin: 0 auto; display: grid; gap: 18px; }
h1, h2, h3 { font-family: var(--font-display); text-wrap: balance; margin: 0; color: var(--navy); }
h1 { font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3.4vw, 2.2rem); line-height: 1.15; letter-spacing: -.01em; }
h2 { font-size: 1.15rem; }
h3 { font-size: 1rem; }
p { margin: 0; }
sub, sup { font-size: .7em; line-height: 0; }
.kicker { font-size: .78rem; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 700; }
header.fiche { display: grid; gap: 10px; }
.pb { border: 1.5px solid var(--red); background: var(--surface); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 10px 14px; font-weight: 700; }
.pb span { color: var(--red); }
.steps { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px 18px; color: var(--muted); font-size: .92rem; padding: 0; margin: 0; list-style: none; }
.steps li b { color: var(--ink); }
.grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.25fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 18px; align-items: start; }
@media (max-width: 860px) { .grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } }
.panel { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 14px; display: grid; gap: 12px; min-width: 0; }
.panel > header { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.hint { color: var(--muted); font-size: .88rem; }

/* sécurité */
.epi { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; }
.chip { font: inherit; font-size: .92rem; border: 1.5px solid var(--line); background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--ink); border-radius: 999px; padding: 6px 12px; cursor: pointer; }
.chip[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--green); background: var(--green-soft); color: var(--green); font-weight: 700; }
.chip:focus-visible, button:focus-visible, select:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--navy); outline-offset: 2px; }

/* porte-tubes */
.rack { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(78px, 1fr)); gap: 6px; background: var(--surface-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 10px 8px 6px; }
.tube { font: inherit; background: none; border: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; padding: 4px 2px 2px; cursor: pointer; display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 2px; color: var(--ink); }
.tube[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--navy); background: var(--navy-soft); }
.tube svg { width: 52px; height: 178px; overflow: visible; }
.tube .lab { font-size: .72rem; line-height: 1.15; text-align: center; min-height: 2.3em; color: var(--muted); }
.tube .num { font-weight: 700; font-size: .8rem; }
.glass { fill: var(--glass-fill); stroke: var(--glass); stroke-width: 2; }
.drop { animation: fall .55s ease-in forwards; }
@keyframes fall { from { transform: translateY(-34px); opacity: 1; } to { transform: translateY(var(--dy, 120px)); opacity: .2; } }
.ppt circle { transition: fill 9s linear, opacity .9s ease, transform 2.2s ease-in; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .drop { animation: none; opacity: 0; } .ppt circle { transition: none; } }
.bench-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }
.sel-info { flex: 1 1 220px; min-width: 0; font-size: .92rem; }

/* flacons */
.bottles { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(150px, 1fr)); gap: 8px; }
.bottle { font: inherit; text-align: left; border: 1.5px solid var(--line); background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--ink); border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 10px; cursor: pointer; display: grid; gap: 4px; }
.bottle:hover { border-color: var(--navy); }
.bottle .nm { font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; }
.bottle .io { font-size: .85rem; color: var(--muted); }
.bottle .act { font-size: .78rem; color: var(--navy); font-weight: 700; }
.bottle.reagent { background: var(--navy-soft); }
.bottle[disabled] { opacity: .45; cursor: not-allowed; }
.pic { display: flex; gap: 4px; }
.pic img { width: 30px; height: 30px; }
.swatch { display: inline-block; width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid var(--glass); vertical-align: -1px; margin-right: 4px; }

button.btn { font: inherit; font-weight: 700; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 14px; cursor: pointer; border: 1.5px solid var(--navy); background: var(--navy); color: var(--surface); }
button.btn.ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--navy); }
button.btn.warn { border-color: var(--red); color: var(--red); background: transparent; }
button.btn[disabled] { opacity: .45; cursor: not-allowed; }

/* messages */
.toast { border-radius: 8px; padding: 9px 12px; font-size: .95rem; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--surface-2); }
.toast.err { border-color: var(--red); background: var(--red-soft); }
.toast.ok { border-color: var(--green); background: var(--green-soft); }
.toast.info { border-color: var(--amber); background: var(--amber-soft); }

/* carnet */
.log { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 6px; max-height: 260px; overflow-y: auto; }
.log li { font-size: .92rem; border-left: 3px solid var(--line); padding: 2px 0 2px 10px; }
.log li.pos { border-left-color: var(--navy); }
.log li:empty { display: none; }
.log .t { color: var(--muted); font-size: .8rem; }

/* tableaux */
.tablewrap { overflow-x: auto; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--surface); }
table { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: .92rem; min-width: 640px; }
th, td { border: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 6px 8px; text-align: center; vertical-align: middle; }
thead th, tbody th { background: var(--navy-soft); color: var(--navy); font-weight: 700; }
tbody th { text-align: left; }
td select { font: inherit; font-size: .88rem; width: 100%; min-width: 0; padding: 4px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); }
td.good select { border-color: var(--green); background: var(--green-soft); }
td.bad select { border-color: var(--red); background: var(--red-soft); }
.row-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }
.checks { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; }
.foot { color: var(--muted); font-size: .82rem; text-align: center; }
details summary { cursor: pointer; font-weight: 700; color: var(--navy); }

/* animation et guide (version 3e) */
.guide { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: center; background: var(--navy); color: var(--surface); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 12px 14px; font-size: 1.05rem; }
.guide b { color: inherit; }
.guide .gn { flex: none; width: 2rem; height: 2rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--surface); color: var(--navy); display: grid; place-items: center; font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; }
.next { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--amber); animation: pulse 1.4s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes pulse { 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 7px color-mix(in srgb, var(--amber) 35%, transparent); } }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .next { animation: none; } }
.bench { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 210px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 12px; align-items: start; }
@media (max-width: 520px) { .bench { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } .stage svg { max-height: 260px; } }
.stage { margin: 0; background: var(--surface-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 8px; display: grid; gap: 6px; justify-items: center; }
.stage svg { width: 100%; max-width: 200px; height: auto; overflow: hidden; }
.stage .caption { font-size: .95rem; text-align: center; min-height: 4.5em; }
.stlbl { font: 700 15px var(--font-body); fill: var(--ink); }
.mots summary { font-size: 1rem; }
.mots dl { display: grid; grid-template-columns: max-content 1fr; gap: 6px 14px; margin: 10px 0 0; }
.mots dt { font-weight: 700; color: var(--navy); }
.mots dd { margin: 0; }
@media (max-width: 520px) { .mots dl { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .mots dd { margin-bottom: 6px; } }
.tube .lab { font-size: .78rem; }
.bottle .act { font-size: .88rem; }

/* version 2 : actions rapides et compte rendu */
.quick { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; justify-content: center; }
.quick:empty { display: none; }
.qbtn { font-size: .9rem; padding: 6px 10px; }
.crform { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; align-items: end; }
.crform label { display: grid; gap: 4px; font-size: .9rem; color: var(--muted); }
.crform input { font: inherit; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); min-width: 0; width: 100%; }
.crform label:first-child { flex: 1 1 220px; } .crform label:nth-child(2) { flex: 0 1 120px; }
.cr { border: 1.5px solid var(--navy); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 14px; background: var(--surface); display: grid; gap: 8px; }
.cr h3, .cr h4 { margin: 4px 0 0; color: var(--navy); font-family: var(--font-display); }
.cr ol, .cr ul { margin: 0; padding-left: 1.3em; display: grid; gap: 4px; }
.cr table { min-width: 0; font-size: .88rem; } .cr td, .cr th { text-align: left; }
.cr .t { display: none; } .cr[hidden] { display: none; }
.codebox { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }
.codebox input { font: inherit; width: 9em; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); text-transform: uppercase; }

/* version 3 : question ion utile, mode économe */
.ask { display: grid; gap: 8px; max-width: 260px; font-size: .92rem; text-align: center; }
.ask .toast { text-align: left; }
body.eco *, body.eco *::before, body.eco *::after { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; }
#effacer { font-size: .85rem; padding: 4px 10px; margin-left: 6px; }

/* version 4 : manipulations pilotées par l'élève */
.vol { font-size: .92rem; align-self: center; }
#verser { touch-action: none; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; -webkit-touch-callout: none; }
.askbox:empty { display: none; }
.askbox .ask { max-width: 280px; }
.stage svg { overflow: visible; }

.qtitle { width: 100%; text-align: center; font-size: .92rem; margin: 2px 0 0; }
.quick .qbtn.next { font-size: .95rem; }
.prof { margin: -4px 0 0; color: var(--navy); font-size: 1rem; }

/* protocole de la fiche */
.proto { border: 1.5px solid var(--navy); border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--surface); padding: 10px 12px; }
.proto summary { font-weight: 700; color: var(--navy); cursor: pointer; }
.proto ol { list-style: none; margin: 10px 0 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 6px; }
.proto li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 4.6em minmax(0, 1fr) 1.4em; gap: 8px; align-items: start; font-size: .92rem; padding: 6px 8px; border-radius: 8px; }
.proto li.partie { display: block; grid-template-columns: none; font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; color: var(--navy); padding: 6px 0 0; font-size: .95rem; }
.proto .q { font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); font-size: .8rem; padding-top: 2px; }
.proto .st { font-weight: 700; color: var(--green); text-align: center; }
.proto li.cur { background: var(--amber-soft); outline: 1.5px solid var(--amber); }
.proto li.cur .st { color: var(--amber); }
.proto li.fait .tx { color: var(--muted); }
.proto li.fait { background: var(--green-soft); }
.proto ul { list-style: none; margin: 4px 0 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 2px; }
.proto ul li { display: block; padding: 0; font-size: .88rem; background: none; outline: none; }
.proto ul li.fait { color: var(--green); background: none; }

#prototout { margin-top: 8px; }
.proto:not(.tout) #proto > li:not(.cur) { display: none; }
.proto li { grid-template-columns: 4.2em minmax(0, 1fr) 1.4em; }

/* Compléments pour les TP de Terminale (thème sombre doux : graphite de paillasse, accents or EFIR) */
:root[data-theme="dark"] { --bg: #1c1f25; --surface: #24282f; --surface-2: #2b3038; --line: #3b414c; --navy: #9cc3ee; --navy-soft: #2e3542; --gold: #c4b5fd; }
body { background: radial-gradient(120% 80% at 20% 0%, #282c34, #1c1f25 60%) fixed; }
h1 { color: #fff; } .kicker { color: var(--gold); }
.retour { display: inline-block; margin: 0 0 8px; font-weight: 700; color: #8fb8ef; text-decoration: none; }
.donnees { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(230px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
.donnees > div { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 12px; background: var(--surface-2); font-size: .93rem; }
.donnees b { color: var(--gold); }
.scene { width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #2e333c, #23272e); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; }
.etapes { display: grid; gap: 8px; }
.etapes .btn { justify-content: flex-start; text-align: left; }
.etapes .btn.fait { border-color: var(--green); color: var(--green); background: var(--green-soft); }
.etapes .btn.fait::before { content: "✓ "; }
.ligne { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }
.ligne input, .ligne select, td input { font: inherit; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); width: 7.5em; }
td input { width: 6em; text-align: center; } .ligne select { width: auto; }
td.good input { border-color: var(--green); background: var(--green-soft); } td.bad input { border-color: var(--red); background: var(--red-soft); }
.afficheur { font: 700 1.6rem "Courier New", monospace; color: #7dffcf; background: #04140f; border: 2px solid #1f5c48; border-radius: 8px; padding: 4px 14px; letter-spacing: .06em; min-width: 6.5em; text-align: right; box-shadow: inset 0 0 12px rgba(0,0,0,.6); }
.afficheur.instable { color: #ffd27a; }
.sols { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(118px, 1fr)); gap: 8px; }
.sols button { font: inherit; font-size: .88rem; border: 1.5px solid var(--line); background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--ink); border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px; cursor: pointer; display: grid; gap: 2px; text-align: center; }
.sols button[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--gold); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(196,181,253,.35); }
.sols button.mesure { border-color: var(--green); }
.sols small { color: var(--muted); font-size: .78rem; }
canvas.graphe { width: 100%; height: auto; background: #20242b; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; display: block; }
.radios { display: grid; gap: 6px; } .radios label { display: block; padding-left: 1.7em; text-indent: -1.7em; cursor: pointer; } .radios input { margin: 0 .5em 0 0; }
textarea.zone { width: 100%; font: inherit; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); }
.verrou { opacity: .5; pointer-events: none; }
.cr img { max-width: 100%; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line); }
td.good select { border-color: var(--green); background: var(--green-soft); } td.bad select { border-color: var(--red); background: var(--red-soft); }
td select { font: inherit; font-size: .9rem; padding: 4px 6px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); }
table.avc td, table.avc th { text-align: center; white-space: nowrap; }
.ordre { display: grid; gap: 6px; } .ordre label { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; } .ordre select { flex: none; }
.ordre .good select { border-color: var(--green); background: var(--green-soft); } .ordre .bad select { border-color: var(--red); background: var(--red-soft); }
.curseurs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; gap: 6px 10px; align-items: center; } .curseurs input[type=range] { width: 100%; accent-color: #c4b5fd; }
.formule { font: 700 1.05rem "Courier New", monospace; color: var(--gold); }
.serie td input[type=checkbox] { width: auto; }
.mini table { min-width: 0; }
/* guidage : prochaine action attendue */
.btn.next, select.next, .sols button.next { border-color: #c4b5fd !important; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(196,181,253,.55), 0 0 16px rgba(196,181,253,.45); animation: suivant 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes suivant { 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(196,181,253,.2), 0 0 4px rgba(196,181,253,.15); } }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .btn.next, select.next, .sols button.next { animation: none; } }
.guide { border-left: 3px solid #c4b5fd; padding: 6px 10px; background: rgba(196,181,253,.08); border-radius: 6px; font-size: .95rem; color: #E5E7EB; }
.wrap { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
.panel { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }

/* matériel illustré */
.mat { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(190px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
.mat-c { margin: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 56px 1fr; gap: 10px; align-items: start; padding: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface-2); }
.mat-c svg { width: 56px; height: 54px; color: #cfe3ff; }
.mat-c figcaption { display: grid; gap: 2px; font-size: .88rem; } .mat-c b { color: var(--gold); } .mat-c small { color: #7dffcf; font-size: .8rem; }
/* prise en main */
.pem-et { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .pem-et span { padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: .9rem; }
.pem-et span.fait { border-color: var(--green); color: var(--green); background: var(--green-soft); } .pem-et span.fait::before { content: "✓ "; }
.quiz { display: grid; gap: 10px; } fieldset.qz { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 12px; margin: 0; display: grid; gap: 4px; }
fieldset.qz legend { font-weight: 700; padding: 0 4px; } fieldset.qz label { cursor: pointer; }
.qok { color: var(--green) !important; } .qko { color: #ff9b9b !important; }
.schema-sonde { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 220px) 1fr; gap: 14px; align-items: center; } @media (max-width: 640px) { .schema-sonde { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
.schema-sonde ol { margin: 0; padding-left: 1.3em; font-size: .9rem; display: grid; gap: 3px; }

/* paillasse interactive */
.scene [data-o] { cursor: pointer; outline: none; }
.scene [data-o]:hover, .scene [data-o]:focus-visible { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 5px rgba(196,181,253,.95)); }
.scene [data-o].cible { animation: lueur 1.4s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes lueur { 0%, 100% { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 1px rgba(196,181,253,.3)); } 50% { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 10px #c4b5fd) drop-shadow(0 0 3px #c4b5fd); } }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .scene [data-o].cible { animation: none; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px #c4b5fd); } }
.scene { touch-action: manipulation; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; }
details.cmd > summary { cursor: pointer; color: var(--muted); font-size: .9rem; } details.cmd[open] > summary { margin-bottom: 8px; }
.guide b.geste { color: #c4b5fd; }

/* Activités documentaires de 3e (AD) : frise, cartes, questions */
.qcard { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 14px; background: var(--surface-2); display: grid; gap: 8px; }
.qcard .qt { font-weight: 700; } .qcard .qt b.n { color: var(--chi, #c4b5fd); margin-right: 6px; }
.qcard.juste { border-color: rgba(123,224,180,.6); }
.qs { display: grid; gap: 12px; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr); }
.qcard { min-width: 0; } .qcard > * { min-width: 0; }
.trou select { font: inherit; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); margin: 2px 2px; max-width: 100%; }
.trou { line-height: 2.1; }
/* frise */
.frise { display: grid; gap: 8px; counter-reset: rang; }
.etape { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2.2em 7.5em 10em minmax(0,1fr) 92px; gap: 6px; align-items: stretch; }
.etape .rg { display: grid; place-items: center; font: 700 1.1rem var(--font-display, inherit); color: #c4b5fd; border-left: 3px solid #c4b5fd; }
.cell { min-height: 64px; border: 1.5px dashed var(--line); border-radius: 10px; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 4px; text-align: center; font-size: .86rem; color: var(--soft, #9aa3b2); cursor: pointer; background: rgba(0,0,0,.12); }
.cell.vide::before { content: attr(data-lib); font-size: .75rem; }
.cell.plein { border-style: solid; color: var(--ink); background: var(--surface-2); }
.cell.cible { border-color: #c4b5fd; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(196,181,253,.25); }
.cell.good { border-color: rgba(123,224,180,.9); } .cell.bad { border-color: #ff9a8f; background: rgba(255,120,110,.08); }
.frise-h span { text-align: center; }
.frise-h { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2.2em 7.5em 10em minmax(0,1fr) 92px; gap: 6px; font-size: .74rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .05em; color: var(--soft, #9aa3b2); }
.pool { display: grid; gap: 10px; position: sticky; bottom: 0; z-index: 3; max-height: 38vh; overflow-y: auto; background: var(--surface, #24282f); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; padding: 8px 10px; box-shadow: 0 -8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.35); }
.pool h4 { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: .85rem; color: var(--soft, #9aa3b2); }
.pool .cartes { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; }
.carte { font: inherit; font-size: .86rem; color: var(--ink); background: var(--surface-2); border: 1.5px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 10px; cursor: grab; text-align: left; max-width: 100%; }
.carte[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: #c4b5fd; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(196,181,253,.3); }
.carte.date { font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.carte.sch { padding: 4px; } .carte svg, .cell svg { width: 76px; height: 76px; display: block; }
.carte.sci, .cell .sci { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }
.portrait { width: 34px; height: 34px; flex: none; }
.cell .sci { flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; font-size: .8rem; }
.visu { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 220px minmax(0,1fr); gap: 14px; align-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px; background: rgba(0,0,0,.15); }
.visu svg { width: 220px; height: 220px; }
.visu p { margin: 4px 0; }
@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .frise-h { display: none; }
  .etape { grid-template-columns: 2em minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr); }
  .etape .rg { grid-row: span 2; }
  .etape .c-exp { grid-column: 2 / 3; } .etape .c-sch { grid-column: 3 / 4; }
  .visu { grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr); justify-items: center; }
}
.carte svg.portrait, .cell svg.portrait { width: 34px; height: 34px; }
@media (max-width: 760px) { .carte svg:not(.portrait), .cell svg:not(.portrait) { width: 60px; height: 60px; } .carte { font-size: .8rem; padding: 6px 8px; } }
/* AD2 : documents, notation, étiquette, constructeur d'atome */
.doc { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-left: 4px solid #9cc3ee; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 14px; background: rgba(156,195,238,.05); margin: 4px 0 12px; }
.doc-t { font-weight: 700; color: #9cc3ee; margin: 0 0 8px; }
.nota { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; line-height: 1; vertical-align: middle; font-size: .72em; text-align: right; margin-right: 1px; }
.nota sup, .nota sub { font-size: 1em; vertical-align: baseline; position: static; }
.nota-big { font: 700 2rem var(--font-display, inherit); color: #c4b5fd; margin: 0; }
.def { border-left: 3px solid #c4b5fd; padding-left: 10px; }
.trou input { font: inherit; width: 4.5em; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); text-align: center; }
.qcard .ligne input { width: 4.5em; text-align: center; }
.deux { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr); gap: 14px; align-items: start; }
.etiq { background: #f4f1ea; color: #15212d; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 12px; font-size: .9rem; }
.etiq-t { font-weight: 700; font-size: .78rem; letter-spacing: .04em; margin: 0 0 6px; color: #003366; }
.etiq table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; } .etiq td { padding: 2px 4px; border-bottom: 1px dotted #b9b3a6; } .etiq td:nth-child(2) { font-weight: 700; } .etiq td:last-child { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.classe { display: grid; gap: 6px; }
.classe .lgn { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; align-items: center; } .classe .lgn b { min-width: 4.5em; font-size: 1.05rem; }
.classe .lgn.bad b { color: #ff9a8f; } .classe .lgn.good b { color: var(--ok, #7be0b4); }
svg.d3 { width: 100%; max-width: 520px; height: auto; display: block; margin: 6px auto; }
.bati { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 200px minmax(0,1fr); gap: 12px; align-items: center; }
.bati svg { width: 200px; height: 200px; }
.bati .cmd { display: grid; gap: 8px; }
.pas { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .pas span.l { min-width: 6.5em; } .pas output { min-width: 2em; text-align: center; font: 700 1.1rem var(--font-display, inherit); }
.pas button { font: inherit; width: 2.2em; height: 2.2em; border-radius: 50%; border: 1.5px solid var(--line); background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--ink); cursor: pointer; }
.mode { display: flex; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
@media (max-width: 760px) { .deux, .bati { grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr); } .bati { justify-items: center; } }
td input.bad { border-color: #ff9a8f; } td input.good { border-color: var(--ok, #7be0b4); }
.deux > *, .visu > *, .bati > * { min-width: 0; } .doc { min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.etiq table { min-width: 0; } .etiq td { border: 0; border-bottom: 1px dotted #b9b3a6; text-align: left; }
#t3, #t7 { min-width: 520px; }
.nota { font-size: .66em; line-height: 1.02; gap: 0; } .nota sup, .nota sub { font-size: 1em !important; line-height: 1.02; top: auto !important; bottom: auto !important; display: block; }
.nota-big .nota { font-size: .5em; }
.etiq td, .etiq th { color: #15212d !important; background: transparent !important; }
#t3 tbody th { font-size: 1.1rem; }
